name: documentary-video
description: Turn any document (a sales summary, a dashboard's numbers, a history chapter, a science article) into a short documentary-style film: a screenplay, a cast, props and places all designed from that document, filmed in a flat-shaded 3D world in the charts-lib colours with a free camera, rendered in JavaScript and exported as MP4 in your browser. Every figure comes from your source. One standalone HTML file: no other apps, no CDN, works offline.
